terms.note: DECIDED 2026-09-29. EN keeps "Luminous Chronicle" (EN logo: assets/title/logo_en). zh uses a meaning-based title, not the transliteration 路米纳斯编年史: 流光 = "flowing light" and, classically, "the passing of time" (流光易逝), so it carries both Luminous and Chronicle; four-plus-three characters read like established zh titles of localized JRPGs, are searchable on Steam, and avoid the generic 光之… pattern. Check trademark/store-name collisions with the publisher before release.

DECIDED 2026-09-29: EN subtitle stays "The Eight Beacons" (not "Lights"): 灯火 = Beacon everywhere in the game (Great Beacon, beacons lit per region), so the subtitle names the thing the player lights. zh ～八盏灯火～ / ～八盞燈火～.
